name: Ball Ranks Fantasy Sports
description: Serves NFL and NBA fantasy rankings and player projections to agents over a keyless read-only MCP server and a public REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec.

skills.name: Get Season Rankings
skills.description: Returns full-season fantasy rankings for football or basketball, with projected points per player.

skills.name: Get Week Rankings
skills.description: Returns weekly fantasy rankings for a given sport and week, for lineup and waiver decisions.

skills.name: Get Player Projections
skills.description: Returns projection data for an individual player, including projected fantasy points for the period.
